title: —Are you annoyed? he asked
html_source:
Notice how Cranly broke from Latin here.

When he wants to know if Stephen is “annoyed”, or if he is okay, he returns to ordinary speech. Shortly afterwards, he returns to Latin, so he does seem concerned enough for Stephen that he would return to normal speech, but once he believes that Stephen is okay, he quickly returns to more playful Latin in this context.
